text:
Silver Price in 1981
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1981, the LBMA silver price fell 38.0% between 1981-01-30 ($13.15) and 1981-12-31 ($8.15). The highest sampled price was $13.15 in January and the lowest was $8.15 in December. The mean of these observations was $10.01. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
